newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products drop on crude, light ends brighte.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products drop on crude, light ends brighte.

text.p: NWE oil products fell slightly with crude but light ends were relatively firm.
Naphtha fell slightly with crude but swaps were well bid. Three big Med cargoes still hung in the balance.
Gasoline edged lower but cargo activity was picking up after a 60,000 tonne vessel sold last week to the U.S.
Gas oil fell around $4 a tonne on weaker gas oil futures, although high ARA stocks and slack demand from the key German inland market were also to blame.
High sulhphur fuel oil barges fell by around $5-$6, trading near $92 fob ARA, before recovering by around $1.
